segments.text: If you love computer graphics, you have to see this. A developer spent over a year building a complete C++ path tracer
completely from scratch with zero third party libraries. It is called LSE and they coded almost the entire project without any AI assistance. It features
Monte Carlo path tracing, global illumination, atmospheric scattering, and even a custom Blender exporter.
